current: qip_market_ingestion::connector::envelope::MarketEventEnvelope carries a fingerprint: EventFingerprint (connector/envelope.rs:89) computed by connector/dedup.rs::EventFingerprint::of (dedup.rs:65-97) -- SHA-256 over source_id + schema_version + key + event_time + the canonicalized JSON body -- plus qip_financial::quality::Provenance naming the source_id/event_time/ingest_time. This is a real, production-reached payload hash on every canonical record.
gap: The hash is real and carried on every envelope, but it is a dedup fingerprint, not a lineage record: RawEvent.body (the source-native payload) is never retained anywhere after fingerprinting -- StreamJournal (connector/journal.rs) persists only a ledger and a checkpoint, and Tape (tape.rs) is a synthetic demo fixture, not raw venue capture. So there is nothing durable to re-hash and no 'lineage break' integrity check exists, which is exactly what the requirement's verification method asks for. Two further limits: EventFingerprint::of hashes body.to_string() of the decoded serde_json::Value (dedup.rs:81), not the bytes the venue sent, so even a retained RawEvent.body could not prove derivation from the wire bytes; and on the edge path qip_protocols::decoder::message_id (decoder.rs:265) derives an id from venue/feed/partition/sequence -- lineage to the origin sequence, but no payload hash at all.
verification: backend/crates/services/qip-market-ingestion/tests/connector_runtime.rs proves the fingerprint is stable and collision-resistant for dedup, not that a retained raw payload re-hashes to match a stored record -- that test does not exist.
notes: verify: status and flags confirmed (ConnectorFeed reaches the envelope from qip-api feed.rs and qip-deepbrain connectors.rs). Added the decoded-body-not-wire-bytes limit and the edge decoder's origin-sequence id to the gap.

current: Two mechanisms exist and disagree with each other. (1) qip_kernel::sizing_review::SizingProposal (sizing_review.rs:157) correctly only journals a loosening ('larger') proposal on the Topic::SizingReviewed stream without ever moving a live bound -- proven by learning.rs:1242's test asserting sizing_cap_multiplier and sizing_confidence both stay at Decimal::ONE after ten winning fills all favour the larger size. (2) Platform::sizing_confidence (platform.rs:11833), read on every sizeable_theses construction -- i.e. the live DECIDE-path hot loop, per its own doc comment 'the production path rather than a query beside it' -- automatically applies a narrowing discount (COUNTERFACTUAL_SIZING_DISCOUNT) computed from LEARN-stage counterfactual evidence, in place, with no promotion or evaluation gate, proven by learning.rs:1318's test that a persistent pattern of unfavourable declines narrows sizing_confidence to 0.5 automatically. (3) ADR 0063's sizing cap: qip_kernel::sizing_review::cap_multiplier (sizing_review.rs:110) narrows an instrument's weight bound from the per-fill FillScore residuals (TICK-047) and is applied on the DECIDE path at platform.rs:12107 -- a second automatic, in-place narrowing from LEARN-stage evidence.
gap: TICK-048 forbids any online change to sizing 'in place', with no narrowing exception stated. ADR 0055's live auto-narrowing of sizing_confidence from counterfactual (drift-adjacent) evidence is exactly such a change, and learning.rs proves it happens by design, not by oversight. No architecture test forbids this write path from LEARN-stage findings to a live sizing parameter, and one could not pass against the code as it stands today.
verification: backend/crates/runtime/qip-kernel/tests/learning.rs:1318 demonstrates the violation by design; no architecture test enforces the prohibition and none currently could pass.
notes: The narrowing is deliberate and ADR'd (ADR 0055) as a safety-conservative asymmetry (never widens, only narrows, bounded discount) -- but TICK-048 as literally stated does not carve out that exception. This needs an owner/ADR decision on whether the requirement's wording or ADR 0055's mechanism should change, not a silent code fix. verify: INCORRECT confirmed (platform.rs:11833 sizing_confidence reads counterfactual_sizing_multiplier and is read by sizeable_theses at :11744). Added a second instance the assessor did not list: ADR 0063's cap_multiplier from fill residuals, applied at platform.rs:12107. Adjacent, not scored: qip-edge's FillTimes (dispersion.rs) adapts cycle admission and release schedule online from measured fill latency.
